text:
maria: Heads up — I'm seeing a steady climb in memory row remap / ECC activity on pool21-card5. Xid errs + remap count jumped ~3x in last 24h. Kernel log snippet: `GPU5: ECC row remap count=12 since 00:00`
jamal: ugh, same vendor batch that showed up in pool19 earlier? saw something similar yesterday.
sophia: on it. I can run a quick scan across pools for >5 remaps in 48h. sharing query in a sec.
maria: thanks. I'd like to add pool21-card5 to the memory-watchlist and prep a drain plan if it keeps trending up.
infra-bot: Alert: page_retire event recorded for pool21-card5 (evt_id: PR-2026-04-03-77). Row remap delta=+9 in 12h.
oncall: I'll open a maintenance window 2026-04-04 03:00 UTC to drain that card if counts cross threshold. Please post expected perf/cost impact. :calendar:
sophia: here's the scan I'm running:
```
# list GPUs with row_remap_count > 5 in last 48h
SELECT pool, card, sum(remaps) as remaps_48h
FROM gpu_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY pool, card
HAVING sum(remaps) > 5;
```
maria: nice. If we hit 10 remaps in 24h I vote replace. If 6-9 we flag and monitor hourly.
jamal: question — can we route low-priority jobs off pool21 instead of draining to reduce customer impact? Routing policy change would be temporary.
oncall: yes we can set route override, but eviction risk for latency-sensitive traffic. Need approval from quant infra.
sophia: quick numbers: draining 1 card out of 8 in pool21 reduces capacity ~12.5%. Estimated perf hit on tail latency 95p ~ +7-10ms, cost for burst reroute to other pools ~+$350/day if we spin up spot capacity.
maria: okay add these to the incident thread doc and the replacement candidate sheet. I'll tag vendor-sr if we cross 15 remaps.
jamal: also check Xid 79 vs Xid 13 differences — 79 usually indicates corrected ECC row remap, 13 more severe? can someone drop the kernel logs here.
sophia: past 24h kernel excerpt:
`Apr 03 01:14:03 host kernel: nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: GPU5: Xid 79, channel 00000000. ECC: row remap applied.`
`Apr 03 08:42:11 host kernel: nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: GPU5: Xid 13, potential MMIO timeout.`
maria: thanks. Mixed signals. Xid79 with remap suggests degrading memory rows; Xid13 needs closer perf tracing.
oncall: action items: 1) sophia run full 48h scan and post CSV to /ops/gpu-watchlist, 2) jamal draft routing override, 3) maria add card to replacement spreadsheet and vendor SR threshold. I'll coordinate maintenance window.
infra-bot: Note: automatic prefix caching for pool21 reduced rate by 5% during earlier alert window.
maria: I'll follow up after the scan. thumbs if you agree with the thresholds (monitor 6-9, replace >=10 in 24h, vendor SR >=15). :thumbsup:
jamal: 👍
sophia: ✅ will post results in ~12m.
oncall: closing loop — I'll put tentative drain on calendar and update status here after sophia posts the CSV.
